An '''MSE-6 droid''' was part of the crew on board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' when it was hijacked by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. While this mouse droid survived the hijacking with a number of other droids, all clone personnel on board were killed. When [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] arrived on the ''Renown'', they ran into [[BNI-393/Legends|BNI-393]] who brought them back to their shuttle where the surviving droids, including this MSE-6, were hiding. The group later followed a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] through the ship and, after the buzz droids were defeated, returned to the shuttle and escaped before the ''Renown'' exploded.
